text: Chinese culture and more. The subjects are taught in Chinese or English. Students will have the opportunity to visit companies, villages, residential places, scenic sports and historical sites during the period of study. Students will be divided into different groups according to their Chinese ability. In addition to their study, visiting tours and other activities are also available during their stay at Nankai. Note: Due to each group have different schedule, courses and travel destinations, the total expense at Nankai can be different from the following standards: ►Registration fee: RMB 400 per student ►Tuition: RMB 850 per week ►Accommodation: RMB 65 per day (double room) The cost of travel varies based on different destination, transportation, food, accommodations, group size and schedule.
